linux.module-extract.notes: Both reconstruct a module ELF, but selector validation, recovered ranges and publication semantics differ.

non_equivalent_fields.reason: Volatility 3 renderer output does not provide StarMem available/complete/scope/warnings/limits/missing_ranges/source_identity semantics.
StarMem selects by modules-list name or base and revalidates the object immediately before recovery; Volatility 3 accepts a module-structure base directly.
StarMem publishes a .partial ELF plus a manifest for missing pages or exhausted byte limits; Volatility 3 does not expose the same missing-range and partial-publication contract.

linux.mountinfo.notes: Primary mount records overlap, while StarMem deliberately analyzes one selected namespace and can start from a namespace or task address without requiring a complete task ring.

non_equivalent_fields.reason: Volatility 3 renderer output does not provide StarMem available/complete/scope/warnings/limits/missing_ranges/source_identity semantics.
StarMem reports one explicitly selected PID/task/namespace scope per run; Volatility 3 can enumerate all namespaces through its process universe.
StarMem exposes the validated mnt_namespace kernel address, while Volatility 3 MNT_NS_ID is the namespace inode number; these fields are not compared as if they were equivalent.
Volatility 3 renders mount, tagged and superblock option strings; StarMem v0.3 reports validated structural fields and raw flags but not the full procfs-compatible option rendering.

linux.kallsyms.notes: StarMem v0.3 decodes core kallsyms plus defined ELF64 symbols from revalidated module core/init allocations; ftrace and BPF sources remain explicitly unavailable.

non_equivalent_fields.reason: Volatility 3 renderer output does not provide StarMem available/complete/scope/warnings/limits/missing_ranges/source_identity semantics.
Volatility 3 can include core, module, ftrace and BPF sources; StarMem v0.3 compares core and verified module ELF64 symbols while reporting ftrace and BPF unavailable.
Volatility 3 derives symbol size, export status, subsystem and descriptions that StarMem v0.3 does not claim; StarMem retains the verified module address and module name.

linux.kmsg.notes: Both decode legacy and modern printk storage, but time proof, line splitting and metadata rendering differ.

non_equivalent_fields.reason: Volatility 3 renderer output does not provide StarMem available/complete/scope/warnings/limits/missing_ranges/source_identity semantics.
StarMem emits UTC only when an independently proven boot time is supplied; otherwise it retains monotonic nanoseconds instead of inferring wall-clock time.
Volatility 3 renders textual facility/level/caller fields and may split text and dictionary lines; StarMem preserves its own per-record source, numeric facility/flags and text boundaries.

linux.modxview.notes: StarMem correlates the modules list, module_kset and a bounded semantic scan of runtime module_addr_min..module_addr_max with strict candidate validation.

non_equivalent_fields.reason: Volatility 3 renderer output does not provide StarMem available/complete/scope/warnings/limits/missing_ranges/source_identity semantics.
Volatility 3 combines procfs, sysfs and its hidden-module scanner; StarMem v0.3 combines modules list, module_kset and a separately bounded semantic scan with different candidate semantics.
Volatility 3 renders module taints; StarMem emits source-presence reasons and a conservative suspicious verdict whose reliability depends on source completeness.

linux.check-syscall.notes: Both enumerate syscall-table pointers; StarMem validates ownership against symbol-proven core text and strictly enumerated module text ranges.
